title: Fetch every page by cursor
hints: Loop at most max_pages times: body = get(next_url); extend items with body.get("items") or []; read body.get("next_cursor").
Keep a set of cursors you have used; if the new cursor is in it, raise PaginationError. Falling out of the for loop without returning means the budget is spent: raise too.
To build the next URL: parts = urlsplit(url); pairs = [(k, v) for k, v in parse_qsl(parts.query) if k != "cursor"]; pairs.append(("cursor", c)); urlunsplit(parts._replace(query=urlencode(pairs))).
Always rebuild from the original url, never from the previous page's URL, or cursors pile up.
